# Maintenance Backlog Triage

## Situation

Fleet maintenance planners triage a backlog of work orders sourced from three
systems: the CMMS, an IoT sensor feed, and manual inspection logs.

## Problem

No single view reconciles conflicting due dates and severities across sources.
Planners currently prioritize by gut feel.

## Constraints

The system is advisory only. It must never dispatch a work order automatically.
A human planner retains final authority over scheduling.
